additional_info.subject: RE: ID0400924-DC/Si-D/AT-[vn8H0d]- Door Open > Charger Offline CRM:00645000926
additional_info.body:
Hi Daniel,
I have reviewed the charger logs from Jan 16th and 17th and identified the DoorPositionSwitch_BG3_BG4 error, which is causing the charger outlets to be out of order.
This issue can occur due to several reasons:
The front or back door was opened.
Faulty door sensors.
Door switch wiring issues that require further tracing.
Regarding the charger offline issue, we need to inspect the router on-site, as remote investigation is not possible for connectivity problems.
Please plan a site visit to check the wiring and connections for BG3 and BG4.
Additionally, bring the following devices for troubleshooting or replacement, if necessary:
2 x 3SE5232-0HC05:
Door Position Switch (1x NO / 1x NC) for BG3 and BG4.
1 x 8EM5903-0AA01-3AA8:
Router.
Tested Ethernet cable.
SIM card with a data connection.
Let us know if you require NOC remote support during the visit.
Thank you
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
